title: Mission: Mars
description:
HOLD THE LINE ON MARS

Humanity’s future on Mars is under attack. As Sergeant Eric, you must survive a 60-day campaign against increasingly dangerous enemy waves.

GamePlay:

BUILD YOUR COMBAT LOADOUT
Choose from 8 weapons, upgrade your arsenal and equip different combat suits with varying protection levels.

FIGHT WITH YOUR SQUAD
You are not alone. Fight alongside AI teammates and use your squad to hold key defensive positions.

Strategize your defense PREPARE THE BATTLEFIELD
Place mines, use explosive barrels and turn the Martian environment into a defensive kill zone before the next wave arrives.

SURVIVE 60 DAYS
Every day pushes the battle further. Adapt your equipment, improve your defenses and survive long enough to secure humanity’s foothold on Mars.

• FEATURES

• 60-day single-player campaign

• Wave-based FPS combat

• 8 upgradeable weapons

• Multiple combat suits

• AI squadmates

• Mines and environmental explosives

• Character and equipment progression

• Sci-fi environments on Mars
description_short: Survive 60 days on Mars against relentless enemy waves. Upgrade your weapons and combat suit, command your squad, deploy mines and explosives, and defend humanity’s last foothold on the Red Planet
